$comment: Library facts the in-app-purchases checkers read (the app's own facts live in contracts/in-app-purchases.json). Re-verify on every expo-iap upgrade: npm view expo-iap version; read ErrorCode, getAvailablePurchases, restorePurchases and the plugin options in the new source.

mustContain.onlyIncludeActiveItemsIOS: false: read Transaction.all (refunds stay visible) with getAvailablePurchases({ onlyIncludeActiveItemsIOS: false })
mustContain.isConsumable: false: finish the non-consumable with finishTransaction({ purchase, isConsumable: false })

storePin.$comment: expo-iap 5.8.0 picks the Android store at build time: explicit property > task flavor > connected debug device (debug builds only) > play (android/openiap-store.gradle). openiapStore (gradle.properties) or ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_openiapStore (eas.json env, .env) may only pin Play.
